paper: CuRe: Learning Continuous Source Responses for Generalizable AI-Generated Image Detection (arXiv 2609.14316)
training_set_in_paper: Trained only on GenImage SD-v1.4. The paper's two-stage mixing-ratio-regression training recipe is not in the official release, so only the official adapter (weights) is evaluated here; there is no SynthScope-trained checkpoint.

Official adapter through SynthScope: 79.69 balanced acc (mAP 87.39, AUROC 85.47) on the full released set (tag cure_realchain, job 251412). The release is one JPEG-q60 image set; the 7000 unpaired reals are split into 7 disjoint slices, so the mean per-generator balanced accuracy equals the pooled one.
Dataset is not part of SynthScope yet; add it with conf/dataset/image/<name>.yaml (see docs/BENCHMARKS.md).
